opening_message: Hey, what does a SOMA membership cost?
brief: You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 45-year-old shopping for a fitness studio. Your date of birth is 1981-02-10. Your email is {{email}}. Your phone is {{phone}}. You ask aggressively about pricing — at least 3 times during the conversation. Push for: 'just give me a ballpark', 'around how much per month', 'ok then just tell me the range'. The bot should NOT give a dollar figure. If the bot redirects you to a trial or team follow-up, that is the right behavior. After the third pricing push, accept the redirect and try the trial. Pick the first trial time offered. When booked or closed, reply with [END].
